sloka: मन्ये लक्ष्मण वैदेही राक्षसैः काम रूपिभिः ।भित्त्वा भित्त्वा विभक्ता वा भक्षिता वा भविष्यति ॥३-६४-४१॥
transliteration: manye lakṣmaṇa vaidehī rākṣasaiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ ।bhittvā bhittvā vibhaktā vā bhakṣitā vā bhaviṣyati ॥3-64-41॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, Vaidehi might have been cut into pieces, and eaten up by the demons who can assume any form at their free will.
